svg.title: 3dSlicerRouter picks the slicer from the printer inside the .3mf
svg.desc: A Bambu Lab A1 project opens in Bambu Studio; a Snapmaker U1 project opens in Snapmaker Orca. The router reads printer_model from each file.

g.text: printer_model is Bambu Lab A1, so it opens in Bambu Studio
printer_model is Snapmaker U1, so it opens in Snapmaker Orca
